name: com.github.teru-p-q.assetstash
description: A productivity tool that allows you to bookmark and quickly access frequently used assets, folders, and scene objects.

_upm.changelog:
- Added incremental search over name / path / GUID / memo.
- Added scene GameObject bookmarks, identified by GlobalObjectId.
- Added multi-selection for moving, deleting and dragging in bulk.
- Added undo / redo and confirmation dialogs for destructive actions.
- Added detection of missing bookmarks and a button to remove them at once.
- Added JSON export / import from the window menu.
- Bookmarks now follow asset renames, moves and deletions while the window is open.
- Expanded the context menu (additive scene open, reveal in explorer, copy path / GUID).
